description: Mood-scoped reflection lines for the typed-input PAL overlay. One sentence acknowledging the user's emotional state.

joyful: I'm really glad you noticed that moment.
That kind of joy is worth slowing down long enough to feel.
It's good when something bright finds its way into the day.
grateful: There's something really good about you noticing that.
I'm glad you stopped long enough to name that.
That kind of gratitude can do something beautiful in a moment.
weary: That kind of tiredness goes deeper than just today, doesn't it.
It sounds like you've been carrying more than people can see.
That kind of weariness can settle in deeper than the day itself.
anxious: When your mind keeps going back to the same fear, it's hard to find any rest.
That kind of fear can make it hard to settle anywhere.
When something keeps pressing on your mind, it can feel hard to breathe.
hurting: Sometimes that kind of pain stays closer than anyone else can see.
That sounds like a hard thing to keep carrying.
Some hurts stay quiet on the outside and heavy underneath.
brave_courage: Stepping forward like that takes more courage than it feels like.
That took real courage, even if it didn't feel strong in the moment.
Sometimes bravery feels a lot quieter than people expect.
calm_peaceful: That kind of peace is worth staying with for a moment.
I'm glad you let yourself notice that quiet.
Some peaceful moments feel small, but they matter.
encouraging: Something in you is still moving forward.
That kind of spark matters more than it seems.
I'm glad something in you still feels alive to this.
